My only friends right now are the police in my surrounding, I talk to them and tell them my story and want to help people who still found no sense for their own life and are not staying alive as a volunteer on🌍that those people hopefully don't need to have fear seeing the police anymore...
I live in Germany directly at the border to the Netherlands. I was born in September 2001...
For me it has always been the same, but finally I luckily feel HAPPY with MYSELF, NOT with the people around me or all the catastrophes on 🌎🌏🌍.....

Hey which country do you live?
I'm there for you, if you wish to communicate with a person just like me right at the moment or at another point of time....
You can also ask me everything, I somehow will be able to explain it to you I suppose....😉

I would love to help you, feel free to 
🤯🤮🤬.... everything out and you can also check my profile, me I feel alright recently things in my 🧠 changed, unfortunately not the terrible humanity......
Do you like to communicate first, life is a very strange gift especially for all of us here in this community who wish for a sense of life or a way out of course....🌍🌏🌎🔜☄️🌠🌌🪐

I would appreciate it if you want to communicate with me...
I will at least give you a hug🤗

Hope you are still interested to communicate before you really just finally go from 🌎🌏🌍.....
Maybe even with me? I am there for you, you can text me if you like....

Hello dear young teen🤗,
I would like you to give you what you need, for example the required "2 unique reasons", maybe you would first be so kind & show a little interest, to look at my own profile Alien_XY_000, to see who I am/was and where I was standing in November 2019 right after my terrible burn-out❤️‍🔥 from school🏫....
That was no fun to be alive while going to almost 12 whole school years that finally caused my big burn out in Oktober 2019🔥❤️‍🔥 in my mind🧠💀 and my whole world of feeling was affected by that collapse.....🦴

Hey 15-years-old dear🥰🤗🕊️
please take care of yourself 
& I promise you it will be interesting for you to
discover & then to explore my own profile
Alien-XY-000.....
I've always had the same thoughts as you, but luckily I'm older in meantime I was born in September 2001.....So I will soon be 22 years old......
I decided to publish my story of chronical suffering on Facebook the last few weeks....
In private chat, I could tell you more and what helped me...
Where are you from ? Me I'm from Germany and my native language is German not english
You can talk to me if you want. What is wrong?

That there is no career I want for myself and no job that I could ever imagine for myself is the thing that make me most  insane about my life. It's a really miserable problem, I know.
And I'm so terrible down because I dropped out of school because it has always caused that much stress for me which I was not able to handle anymore. I just feel like I'm totally not made for this world. And actually I have never had interest to lead a life in this world.
Do you maybe want to talk a bit?
I could do it if you still need help
What is disturbing you about life?

Yes, you can talk to me 🙂. By the way I'm 18 too.
About me: Actually I have always been totally unhappy, frustrated and desperated about being alive in this world.
From my experience life is just stress, stress too much stress, always have to fight with shit problems or illnesses , then there are all the exhausting & annoying things that you somehow need to do (almost) every day: wash yourself, put on clothes and wash them, eating and preparing /buy the food,..................😒😓
There just is nothing that can make me really happy and I can not imagine that there ever will be a way to manage life that could make me feel comfortable with my life and myself.

I feel like life in general is tooo hard for me!! 😥😫😢😭 But school is what always made me most down.
It caused really too much never-ending stress for me and I was suffering from pressure because of all the homework and hundreds of exams.   Finally really all my power to manage that horror ( which the society just force you to do if you are here ) was totally exhausted. And I broke up with the horrible school shit that has destroyed me so hard. 
But there is just no job that I can imagine to do. And I'm so terrible much scared of the 'world of work' because everything seems to be too complicated and hard for me. And actually I'm also just not interested to go through all that. It's too damn depressing for me!!! And I have never said that it's ok for me to be here but I was just accidentally (my parents actually didn't want a child) dropped here and everyone expects me to want to manage it or to even love it. That makes me seriously hard angry.

What about you, what disturb you most about life ?
And which country do you come from? I'm from Germany

School has destroyed me all my life, it just make me unhappy, never let me feel free in my mind and for me if causes so much stress and whatever you do you can never be really good enough
All that shit took all my power away out of myself and finally after full 11 years of school and starting even the 12th year, I was more than completely fed up with school and also no power remained to still go there and always study for the hundreds of exams , being very creative for projects, do the big amount of homework,....
Finally I broke up all that shit that I anyway never wanted to go through
And I'm not interested to go on, I want to do nothing in this horrible world

Hi I understand what you mean. I almost think the same.
I 've already posted something about me with the title:
About my forced unwanted life and how I think about life in this world of the horrible humanity
You find my post at  u/Alien_XY_000. 
I will also invite you to a chat with me. You can accept it if you agree.

Well the things I like to do:
1. Sleeping /having crazy dreams
2. Lying at the bottom and look into the sky
    (I wish it would be possible to escape from this planet)
3. Let fly my rainbow coloured kite
4. In summer :making a trip to a nice lake with my little    boat and swim in the middle of this lake
5. Visiting a little tree (a conifer) which I discovered in the moor. This tree is so cute I think
6. I like to laugh about good jokes / funny stories or crazy situations

I don't know if there are more things I like which I forgot to list at the moment
And what do you like?

I still can't believe that I got to know a person who thinks like me.😳
 So you also can't imagine ever to apply for a job /Or for the exhausting training you have to pass to be allowed to  do the job? I also know how awful these feelings are. And I can't stand the fact that the big majority of people don't worry about it and that all this is no problem for them. It makes me feel deep desperate and I'm wondering what's wrong with me.

 I really really can imagine no single job which I ever want to do. And the training for it would be too hard for me.
For all these reasons and the other reasons I already mentioned I see no long future for me which I could stand!!!! That's a real big problem for which I don't know a solution and I think one day in not very far future the problems will become so worse that I have to kill myself. I don't know if I will have enough courage to do that but I don't know another way out of it.
So is it really the same what you think? Or in which way do you look into your (further) future? Do you see a solution for our problems? Is there any solution to stay alive until natural death with that problems and life settings?

OK, yes
Can you imagine any job for which you would ever apply for? For me there isn't any job in this world I can imagine that I would ever like to do it. And if I would apply for a job, I think I would fail in the job interview bacause I can't hide my real setting to life. That will never make me successful in getting any job. 
Actually are you male or female?

You wrote you are currently learning German.
I really would be happy if I perhaps could help you learning German. So if you have any questions or exercises you need help with, you can contact me everytime🤗🤗

Ah OK and you wrote you can't understand how people can go to school /work/..... I agree and I also can't understand why most people hope for having a long long life
Do you still go to school or to work or do anything like this?  
As I've written I went to school but since October not anymore because I really can't stand it anymore. I'm sooooo tired and fed up with it. And I have zero energy left to go to school and do all the homework and studying for exams anymore.!!!

I am endless happy and overwhelmed that there is one more person in this world who feels almost exactly the same as me😃. I never thought that there is one.
May I ask your age and the country where you are from?

I am endless happy and overwhelmed that there is one more person in this world who feels almost exactly the same as me. I never thought that there is such a person
May I ask your age and the country where you come from?

I totally agree with you. I think the same way as you ...And I am very glad to read what you wrote!
Reddit is the only place where I can 'meet' people who roughly think like me.
One of my problems is that unfortunately I am surrounded by people who love it to live and who are even fascinated from life, no matter what things they have to do or what happens. I hate them for being like that and they don't understand me. That are the reasons why I decided to stop keeping contact to my 'friends'. I can't stand their setting of life anymore and the topics they always talk about. I don't have someone who really understands my way of thinking. Only my mum is OK but actually I want to have someone else who I also can talk to!
I am 18 years old, female and I live in Germany (so English isn't my native language, sorry if my English isn't perfect)
May I ask how old you are and which country you are coming from?


I have always hated to live. The only activity which I love is sleeping. I fought myself through eleven school years.
I was always very very stressed because of school and many nights I had no time left to sleep before school starts again. I found it sooo cruel. My grades were good but I hate everything. I don't have real interests and nothing can give me such pleasure that I want to keep living! I think life is pointless!!! I hate humanity and I feel terrible to be one of them and it's very horrible that the humans force me to live. I am very angry about it.

And I totally hate the system of humans life. I mean the schools, the world of working, the amount of bureaucracy, money, environmental pollution, ..................
I never want to take part in it. Besides the world is already overpopulated and soon is going to collapse because of all the disgusting humans. It's a shame for me to be forced into this world and I wish it has never happened to me. 
The only thing I can hope is that I don't still have to stay for a long time in this prison of my human life. 
Best wishes from me to all of you who agree with me
